dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's wrong with the conveyor belt?

dialogues.speaker: Rozycki
dialogues.text: Oh, nothing major, the kinetic core overloaded. And the transmission module jammed. And the main valve is locked in place. And some other issues. But besides that, it's fine.

dialogues.speaker: Rozycki
dialogues.text: We've already got a specialist working on it, so it should be up and running again at some point.

dialogues.speaker: Rozycki
dialogues.text: Anyway, you'd better get back on solid ground. Safety first!
